For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the accessible entry/exit pathway via Murray St and Pirrama Rd
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500

infoLinks.urlText: Rockdale Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 2/3 is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Rockdale Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 2/3 is temporarily out of service.
From Sunday 1 February to Monday 13 April 2026, the lift between the Concourse and Platforms 2 and 3 will be closed for upgrades. 

•	For lift access use the lift from the Concourse to Platforms 4 and 5 or use Banksia Station as an alternative
•	If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9563 7574
